
# Storing a value that holds a function that reads the heap is rejected when the function is inside a datatype, a codatatype, a newtype or a subset type; the old check looked only at the type and its type arguments, so a function stored in a datatype could read itself and false was provable (https://github.com/erniecohen/dafny/issues/479).
git-issues/github-issue-479.dfy
